channel.title: The Reading Room
channel.description: Essays and practical reading notes, served locally.

item.title: Build a Reading Habit That Fits
item.description: Make reading a natural part of the day.
item.content:encoded:
Attach reading to an existing moment, such as the first cup of tea.

Keep a short list of interesting next reads.

item.title: The Useful Margin
item.description: Annotations are a conversation with your future self.
item.content:encoded:
A note in the margin can hold a question until you are ready to answer it.

See the companion essay.

item.title: Reading Together, Apart
item.description: A shared list makes room for good conversation.
item.content:encoded:
Trade one article a week with a friend.

  1. Read at your own pace
  2. Bring one question
  3. Enjoy the conversation
